faqSection.deposit-methods-a: CrashX accepts BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB, TRX, SOL, TON, and XRP. Bank cards (VISA / Mastercard) and Apple Pay / Google Pay are supported in eligible regions and convert automatically to USDT so you can bet on Crash immediately.
faqSection.claim-bonus-q: How many times can I claim a bonus?
faqSection.claim-bonus-a: Welcome bonuses are once per account. Reload and Crash leaderboard prizes refresh on a schedule — see Promotions for what applies to Crash play this week.
faqSection.verify-account-q: How do I verify my CrashX account?
faqSection.verify-account-a: Go to Profile → Verification, follow the four steps, and upload the requested documents. Most accounts are verified within 24 hours so you can raise Crash limits.
faqSection.is-safe-a: CrashX operates under a Curaçao gaming licence. Crash outcomes use provably fair seeds you can verify and funds are segregated.
faqSection.withdraw-q: How do I withdraw funds from CrashX?
faqSection.withdraw-a: Go to Profile → Withdraw, choose your asset and network, paste your wallet address, and confirm. On-chain withdrawals are processed quickly after Crash session checks pass.
faqSection.support-q: How can I reach customer support?
faqSection.support-a: Use Live Support on any page. We typically reply within minutes, 24/7 — include your last Crash round time if it's about a bet.

liveChat.title: Live support
liveChat.subtitle: We usually reply in a few minutes.
liveChat.greeting: Hi — CrashX support here. Ask us about Crash rounds, limits, deposits or withdrawals and we'll help right away.
liveChat.agentReplyDeposit: Got it — I’ve routed this to our deposits team. Tell us the coin and network, and if you already sent funds, paste the transaction hash or the exact time and amount.
liveChat.agentReplyWithdraw: Thanks — I’ve queued this for withdrawals. Please share the asset, approximate amount, and the destination address you used (the last few characters are enough if you prefer).
liveChat.agentReplyBonus: Thanks — for bonuses, mention the promo name if you have one. Eligibility often appears within 5–15 minutes after qualifying activity; I’ll have the team double-check your account.
liveChat.autoReply: Thanks for your message. Our team will continue here shortly.
agentReplies: Thanks — I've flagged this for our payments team and we'll update you shortly.
Got it. What's the approximate amount & network you're using?
We can resolve most deposit issues once we see one transaction hash.
For bonuses, eligibility usually shows within 5–15 minutes — want me to check your account tier?
liveChat.nudgeIdle: Still there? Mention your issue in one sentence and we'll route you faster.
liveChat.syncedNotice: Your message was delivered to support.
liveChat.relayFailed: We couldn't confirm delivery right now — keep chatting and try sending again in a moment.

responsibleGaming.title: Responsible Gaming
responsibleGaming.body: Crash can move fast — set deposit and loss limits, cool off when you need to, or self-exclude. We take player wellbeing seriously.

responsibleGaming.selfExclusionBody: Permanently close your account. Once self-excluded, the decision cannot be reversed.
